title: Align VST3 timeline editor naming and bindable fields

summary.behavior: The merged Expert WinUI surface and compatibility preview now use Vst3TimelineEditorViewModelV1. Timeline registration and selected-row value editing use observable two-way fields; safe selection bindings reuse the fail-closed Select path. The seam remains local control-model work and sends no engine IPC or RT-thread work.
summary.api_change: Renamed the editor ViewModel to the #667 acceptance name and added observable NewTimelineIdText/SelectedRowValueText plus a safe writable SelectedTimelineId projection.
summary.scope_boundary: No native supervisor persistence, plugin application, engine synchronization or host automation is claimed.

validation.notes: includes V1 observable-field and safe-selection cases
compatibility preview compiled with the V1 seam

scope: WinUI Expert local timeline editor binding, compatibility preview seam, control-model checks and SPEC-0010 boundary update.
